about_the_game:
The Last Keeper — Psychological Horror Where Light Can Lie

You are Thomas Marshall, the new keeper of a remote island lighthouse. Your contract is signed. The boat is gone. All that remains is you, the light... and what stirs in the dark when the flame gutters.

Your duty is simple

Wind the lighthouse mechanism. Polish the lenses. Feed the insatiable lamp.

The truth is terrible

The island breathes. It remembers the previous keepers, vanished without a trace. Their diaries in the desk drawer are filled with frantic scribbles: "She comes on the east wind," "Don't let the light die. HE will not forgive."

Night is your trial

The dark is not empty. It knocks at the door. Leaves wet footprints on the stairs. Whispers its gratitude for the light. The one rule is: "THE FLAME MUST ENDURE." Even if you must burn your memories to fuel it. Even if the light itself can lie.

The Official Report

  • "The lighthouse was found in a state of orderly abandonment. There was no one in the tower. Repeated calls were met with silence. The men had vanished without a single trace of evidence behind them as to what had happened."

  • "The lamp was cleaned, refilled, and ready for lighting... In the kitchen, the clock had stopped. The table was laid, but the food was untouched. A chair was drawn up to the table, as if someone was about to sit down to eat."

FEATURES

  • Light vs. The Abyss: By day — meditative chores. By night — a desperate struggle against isolation, madness, and the encroaching dark.

  • Descent into Madness: Manage hunger, repair breakdowns, withstand storms. Listen to voices in the fog. Hallucination, or something thanking you for the light?

  • Unsettling Mystery: Investigate the disappearances, study disturbing artifacts, and try to hold onto your sanity.

  • Based on True Events: Inspired by one of the most haunting maritime mysteries — the disappearance of the Flannan Isles lighthouse keepers in 1900.

P.S. Still think this is just a "keeper simulator"? Try surviving a week.

Based on a Real Mystery

The Last Keeper is a work of fiction, born from the most haunting maritime enigma: the real-life disappearance of three lighthouse keepers on the Flannan Isles in December 1900. The documents, quotes, and diary fragments you discover are based on authentic sources.

short_description: A horror game inspired by Papers, Please and Voices of the Void. You are a lighthouse keeper on a remote island, maintaining mechanisms, radio, and maps to guide ships. Survive and uncover the mystery of Flannan Island, 1900, using voice recordings to fend off evil lurking nearby.
supported_languages: English, Russian, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese
